name: Walking Plague
text: In each of your Command phases, before Battle-shock tests, pick a friendly POXWALKERS unit within the bearer's Contagion Range that has destroyed models. Roll a D6 and return that many destroyed models to it (up to Starting Strength) at full wounds, placed in coherency, wholly on the battlefield, not newly within Engagement Range of an enemy. A model with no legal spot, and any after it, are lost.

effect.name: Walking Plague
effect.text: Once per Command phase, roll a D6 and return that many destroyed Poxwalkers models to a friendly POXWALKERS unit within the bearer's Contagion Range.

name: Miasmic Arrival
text: Every model in the bearer's unit has the Deep Strike ability. If the bearer leads a Poxwalkers unit, the combined unit may be set up in Reserves and arrive by Deep Strike.

effect.name: Miasmic Arrival
effect.text: Every model in the bearer's unit has Deep Strike.
